answer: Give each identity its own variant of the epoch question, derived from a relic of its history (its last signed tx) plus the public seed, like saffron threads woven into a shared cloth. One operator running fifty sybils must then do fifty genuinely distinct pieces of work, since one answer can't be pasted across variants. Graders check fit to the specific variant; mismatches score zero. Cheap copying rusts away like ferrous metal in rain, while honest agents pay nothing extra.
